primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the LORD’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in the LORD’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: When they brought out the money that was brought into the LORD’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the LORD’s law given by Moses.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the LORD’s word by Moses.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.
